comment: Producer-run captures (PLEX, 2026-08-13, deployed build c252d4b, agent-facing tool route, principal=direct). Three distinct codes from ONE op on ONE surface prove the gate is a function of state, not a constant refusal. The order IS part of the contract: connection liveness, then cursor shape, then poll grant. A revoked connection can NEVER emit poll_grant_required regardless of grants -- it is refused two gates earlier. Store verified: zero subscriptions committed for all three. The accept arm (well-formed subscribe with a covering grant succeeds) exists in production (conn-github-prs -> list_pull_requests) and is what stops a constant-reject implementation passing this set.
